channel.title: Modiwall Journal
channel.description: Short reads on living walls and vertical gardens in South Africa.

item.title: Do plants clean the air? Not really.
item.description: The truth about plants and indoor air quality, what a 2019 review found, and the reasons to live with a green wall anyway.

item.title: How much light does an indoor wall need?
item.description: Lux figures for an indoor living wall, how to measure them with a phone, and what to do when a room is too dark for plants.

item.title: Living or artificial? Four honest questions
item.description: Light, water, access and how close people will stand: four questions that tell you whether a wall should be living or artificial.

item.title: Drawing a living wall into the building
item.description: What to draw first when a living wall is part of the building: structure, reservoir, power, light and access, with Modiwall module data.

item.title: The bathroom is a better garden than you think
item.description: Humidity, warmth and filtered light make a bathroom one of the best rooms in the house for a living wall. What to plan before the tiler starts.

item.title: What sets the price of a living wall
item.description: The five things that set the price of a living wall or vertical garden in South Africa, and the questions to ask before you compare two quotes.

item.title: The wall at the end of the pool
item.description: How to turn a bare boundary or pool wall into a garden with no flower bed, and what sun, wind and reflected heat ask of the planting.

item.title: A hospital, a resort and two golds
item.description: A hospital atrium that lives on daylight and a steel tree under a skylight: the stories behind two SALI gold-awarded Modiwalls.

item.title: What a living wall does for you
item.description: What a living wall does for stress, focus, quiet and comfort, with the research behind it. By Charl of Modiwall.

item.title: Why living walls fail
item.description: Water, light, plant choice and care: the four ways living walls die, and the questions that tell you whether yours will last.
